facts.fact: 有味道的蜗牛守卫 Eddie 带两人穿过监狱院子，路程大半在户外，气味散掉了
facts.anchor: most of this trek was outside, which dissipated the odor

facts.fact: 个案工作者 Martina Becerra 当面嘲弄典狱长 Gubler，说他除了做俯卧撑，只做非做不可的事
facts.anchor: Warden Goober doesn’t do anything he doesn’t have to.

facts.fact: Martina 一关上门就断言 Deirdre 既不会自杀、也不会意外用药过量
facts.anchor: Deedee didn’t kill herself. Or accidentally OD.

facts.fact: Martina 说她与 Deirdre 共事六年，且说认识时对方就已「煮透了」
facts.anchor: I’ve been working with her for six years

facts.fact: Martina 主动说出 Genevieve 的母亲 Cheryl Spruce 曾多次探视 Deirdre
facts.anchor: You know Genevieve’s mother visited Deedee? Multiple times.

facts.fact: Martina 记得最后一次探视就在复活节后，约六周之前，且那次只有 Rose 一个人来
facts.anchor: just after Easter, so it had to be about six weeks ago

facts.fact: Deirdre 的长程出狱计划是把表亲家在圣迭戈当落脚处，先住满一年
facts.anchor: She had a cousin in San Diego

facts.fact: Deirdre 出狱前一天最后想做的一件事，是再去爬一次她争取来的室内攀岩墙
facts.anchor: one last activity she wanted to do before she left
